findings.label: Write-but-not-draw on non-projectile damage
findings.detail: The PanelSystem_RefreshBindings walk ignores is_enabled, so the damage pull writes object->damage for any selected object even when SetParentEnabledState(..., is_projectile) has parent-disabled the row. This is the design's explicit option (a) and matches the pre-change behaviour (the old state_fields[] row also wrote for any selected object). Not blocking; no action required.
